blurb.en: Warning letters, repeats, doubts about your course, and the friends who carry you. About 6 minutes.
blurb.zu: Izincwadi zesixwayiso, ukuphinda, ukungabaza isifundo sakho, nabangane abakuphathayo. Cishe imizuzu emi-6.

text.en: Second-semester tests, including any module you're repeating.
text.zu: Izivivinyo zesemesta yesibili, kuhlanganise nanoma yisiphi isifundo osiphindayo.

label.en: A plan made with an advisor

title.en: A failed module blocks your registration
title.zu: Isifundo owehluleke kuso sivimba ukubhalisa kwakho

text.en: You registered your modules for the whole year in January. The one you failed is a prerequisite for a second-semester module, and the system is about to block it.
text.zu: Ubhalise izifundo zakho zonyaka wonke ngoJanuwari. Leso owehluleke kuso siyadingeka ngaphambi kwesifundo sesemesta yesibili, futhi uhlelo seluzosivimba.

outcome.en: Three weeks in, the system removes you from the blocked module. The time you put into it is gone.
outcome.zu: Emasontweni amathathu, uhlelo lukukhipha esifundweni esivinjiwe. Isikhathi osichithe kuso sihambile.

outcome.en: The faculty handbook lists a module you can take instead this semester. You swap before the deadline.
outcome.zu: Incwadi yefakhalthi ibala isifundo ongasithatha esikhundleni kule semesta. Ushintsha ngaphambi komnqamulajuqu.

tip.en: The faculty handbook on the university website lists the prerequisites and alternatives for every module.
tip.zu: Incwadi yefakhalthi kuwebhusayithi yenyuvesi ibala izidingo nezinye izindlela zesifundo ngasinye.

outcome.en: The advisor finds a substitute where one exists and deregisters the module that's blocked. Your timetable works again.
outcome.zu: Umeluleki uthola isifundo esingena esikhundleni lapho sikhona futhi akhiphe isifundo esivinjiwe. Uhlelo lwakho lwezifundo luyasebenza futhi.

tip.en: After every results release, check which modules your failed module blocks, before registration closes.
tip.zu: Emva kwayo yonke imiphumela, hlola ukuthi isifundo owehluleke kuso sivimba ziphi, ngaphambi kokuvalwa kokubhalisa.

title.en: You passed, but not by enough

text.en: You registered for the whole year in January. You passed {mod1}, but your mark is below what the second-semester module you chose requires.
text.zu: Ubhalisele unyaka wonke ngoJanuwari. Uphase i-{mod1}, kodwa amamaki akho angaphansi kwalokho okudingwa yisifundo sesemesta yesibili osikhethile.

outcome.en: Two weeks in, the system removes you from the module. You join the other version late and have to catch up.
outcome.zu: Emasontweni amabili, uhlelo lukukhipha esifundweni. Ujoyina enye inguqulo sekwephuzile futhi kufanele ufice.

outcome.en: You change to the version of the module your mark allows, before the deadline. You start it on day one.
outcome.zu: Ushintshela enguqulweni yesifundo evunyelwa amamaki akho, ngaphambi komnqamulajuqu. Uyiqala ngosuku lokuqala.

tip.en: Module changes are made on the student portal or at your faculty office, before the published deadline.
tip.zu: Ukushintsha izifundo kwenziwa kuphothali yabafundi noma ehhovisi lefakhalthi yakho, ngaphambi komnqamulajuqu oshicilelwe.

label.en: Ask an advisor what it changes

outcome.en: The advisor shows you which version still leads to the second-year modules you want, and fixes your registration.
outcome.zu: Umeluleki ukukhombisa ukuthi yiyiphi inguqulo esaholela ezifundweni zonyaka wesibili ozifunayo, futhi alungise ukubhalisa kwakho.

tip.en: After results, check the entry marks for your next modules before the change deadline.
tip.zu: Emva kwemiphumela, hlola amamaki okungena ezifundweni zakho ezilandelayo ngaphambi komnqamulajuqu wokushintsha.

text.en: Tests are next week and one {mod1} topic still doesn't make sense. Your lecturer has consultation hours on Tuesdays, but you've never been.
text.zu: Izivivinyo zingesonto elizayo futhi isihloko esisodwa se-{mod1} asikezwakali. Umfundisi wakho unamahora okubonisana ngoLwesibili, kodwa awukaze uye.

events.research: Understanding Students Issue 2: few students talk to lecturers

outcome.en: It feels easier not to go. The same mistakes show up in your next assignment.
outcome.zu: Kuzwakala kulula ukungayi. Amaphutha afanayo avela emsebenzini wakho olandelayo.

outcome.en: They reply with two tips and a link to past papers.
outcome.zu: Baphendula ngamathiphu amabili nesixhumanisi samaphepha angaphambili.

tip.en: Lecturers' email addresses and consultation times are in the module guide. Write from your student email and give your student number.
tip.zu: Amakheli e-imeyili abafundisi nezikhathi zokubonisana kusemhlahlandleleni wesifundo. Bhala nge-imeyili yakho yomfundi futhi unikeze inombolo yakho yomfundi.

outcome.en: Ten minutes, and they remember your name afterwards. You finally get the topic that kept tripping you up.
outcome.zu: Imizuzu eyishumi, futhi bayalikhumbula igama lakho emva kwalokho. Ekugcineni uqonda isihloko ebesilokhu sikuphazamisa.

title.en: Repeating a module alongside new ones

text.en: Your timetable now has the module you failed plus a full new load. Two lectures clash on Wednesdays.
text.zu: Uhlelo lwakho lwezifundo manje lunesifundo owehluleka kuso kanye nomthwalo omusha ogcwele. Izifundo ezimbili ziyangqubuzana ngoLwesithathu.

outcome.en: You're in every lecture you can make, and exhausted by Thursday.
outcome.zu: Ukhona kuzo zonke izifundo ongakwazi ukuya kuzo, futhi ukhathele ngoLwesine.

outcome.en: One elective moves to next year. The repeat gets the time it needs.
outcome.zu: Isifundo esisodwa sokuzikhethela sithuthela onyakeni ozayo. Ukuphinda kuthola isikhathi esikudingayo.

outcome.en: The advisor finds a class group without the clash. Your semester suddenly fits.
outcome.zu: Umeluleki uthola iqembu lekilasi elingangqubuzani. Isemesta yakho ngokungazelele iyalingana.

text.en: A shop near campus offers you weekend and evening shifts: about R300 a week.
text.zu: Isitolo eduze nekhampasi sikunikeza amashifu ezimpelasonto nakusihlwa: cishe u-R300 ngesonto.

outcome.en: Money stops being a daily worry. Study time shrinks.
outcome.zu: Imali iyayeka ukuba yinkathazo yansuku zonke. Isikhathi sokufunda siyancipha.

outcome.en: You keep your evenings for study and ask them to keep your CV.
outcome.zu: Ugcina izikhathi zakho zakusihlwa zokufunda futhi ubacele bagcine i-CV yakho.

outcome.en: One weekend shift. A little money, without losing your week.
outcome.zu: Ishifu elilodwa lempelasonto. Imali encane, ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa yisonto lakho.

text.en: Everyone else seems to love {course}. You're not sure you even like it.
text.zu: Wonke umuntu ubonakala eyithanda i-{course}. Awuqiniseki ukuthi uyayithanda nawe.

outcome.en: You fill in the form, then stop at the last line. Leaving is a real option, but you want to decide it with facts, not on a bad week.
outcome.zu: Ugcwalisa ifomu, bese ume emugqeni wokugcina. Ukuhamba kuyindlela yangempela, kodwa ufuna ukunquma ngamaqiniso, hhayi ngesonto elibi.

outcome.en: You keep your head down and the doubt stays. It may pass, but it's worth talking through before next year's registration.
outcome.zu: Uqhubeka ngokuzithoba kodwa ukungabaza kuyahlala. Kungase kudlule, kodwa kufanele kuxoxwe ngakho ngaphambi kokubhalisa konyaka ozayo.

outcome.en: You find out which credits would carry over. Knowing the options calms you down.
outcome.zu: Uthola ukuthi yimaphi amakhredithi angadluliselwa. Ukwazi izindlela kuyakuthulisa.

tip.en: Your faculty office handles course changes. Ask which credits transfer, and when internal transfer applications close.
tip.zu: Ihhovisi lefakhalthi yakho liphatha ukushintsha izifundo. Buza ukuthi yimaphi amakhredithi adluliswayo, nokuthi izicelo zokudlulisela zivalwa nini.

outcome.en: The careers advisor shows you jobs your degree leads to that you'd never heard of. One of them sounds like you.
outcome.zu: Umeluleki wemisebenzi ukukhombisa imisebenzi iziqu zakho eziholela kuyo obungakaze uyizwe. Omunye wayo uzwakala ufana nawe.

text.en: A close friend leaves university, and loneliness comes back. {memory}
text.zu: Umngane osondelene nawe ushiya inyuvesi, futhi isizungu siyabuya. {memory}

outcome.en: You eat alone and skip the group chat. The weeks get longer.
outcome.zu: Udla wedwa futhi weqe iqembu lokuxoxa. Amasonto aba made.

outcome.en: You call every Sunday. They're doing okay, and so are you.
outcome.zu: Uyabashayela njalo ngeSonto. Bayaphila, nawe uyaphila.

outcome.en: You join a society's weekly meet-up. Slowly, a new group forms around you.
outcome.zu: Ujoyina umhlangano wenhlangano wamasonto onke. Kancane kancane, iqembu elisha liyakheka eduze kwakho.

title.en: The friend you came with leaves

text.en: The friend you came to university with is leaving, and loneliness comes back. {memory}
text.zu: Umngane owafika naye enyuvesi uyahamba, futhi isizungu siyabuya. {memory}

title.en: Your funding is at risk: appeal

text.en: A message from your funder: your results may not meet the rules to keep funding. You can appeal.
text.zu: Umlayezo ovela kumxhasi wakho: imiphumela yakho ingase ingahlangabezani nemithetho yokugcina uxhaso. Ungadlulisa icala.

outcome.en: You don't appeal. Next year's funding is now a question mark.
outcome.zu: Awudlulisi icala. Uxhaso lwangonyaka ozayo manje luwumbuzo.

outcome.en: You attach your results plan and a letter explaining what happened. Now you wait.
outcome.zu: Unamathisela uhlelo lwemiphumela yakho nencwadi echaza okwenzekile. Manje uyalinda.

tip.en: Appeal forms and deadlines are on your funder's portal. Attach your results, a short explanation and any proof.
tip.zu: Amafomu ezikhalazo nemingcele yesikhathi akuphothali yomxhasi wakho. Namathisela imiphumela yakho, incazelo emfushane nanoma yibuphi ubufakazi.

outcome.en: The SRC has helped with dozens of appeals. Yours goes in on time, with the right documents.
outcome.zu: I-SRC isize ngezicelo eziningi. Esakho sihanjiswa ngesikhathi, namadokhumenti afanele.

title.en: You passed the module you failed

text.en: The repeat paid off. You passed it, and it doesn't feel like a scar anymore.
text.zu: Ukuphinda kuye kwaba nemiphumela. Uphasile, futhi akusazwakali njengesibazi.

text.en: You got sick for a week. Your friends brought soup, notes from every lecture and very bad jokes.
text.zu: Ugule isonto lonke. Abangane bakho baletha isobho, amanothi avela kuzo zonke izifundo namahlaya amabi kakhulu.

text.en: Second-semester tests, including any module you're repeating.
text.zu: Izivivinyo zesemesta yesibili, kuhlanganise nanoma yisiphi isifundo osiphindayo.

text.en: Your faculty emails: after a full year of results, you've made the Dean's List. Screenshot sent to the family group.
text.zu: Ifakhalthi yakho ithumela i-imeyili: emva konyaka wonke wemiphumela, usohlwini lukaDini. Isithombe-skrini sithunyelwe eqenjini lomndeni.

text.en: Do you know how many modules you must pass this year to be allowed to continue?
text.zu: Uyazi ukuthi zingaki izifundo okufanele uziphase kulo nyaka ukuze uvunyelwe ukuqhubeka?

outcome.en: The faculty handbook gives the credits you must pass each year to avoid academic exclusion. Now you know where your line is.
outcome.zu: Incwadi yefakhalthi inikeza amakhredithi okufanele uwaphase unyaka ngamunye ukuze ugweme ukukhishwa. Manje uyazi ukuthi umugqa wakho ukuphi.

outcome.en: Fair enough. It is under "progression" or "exclusion rules" on the university website, or ask your faculty office.
outcome.zu: Kulungile. Kungaphansi kwe-"progression" noma "exclusion rules" kuwebhusayithi yenyuvesi, noma ubuze ehhovisi lefakhalthi yakho.
